sql: SELECT chrom, start, "end", allele_string, CASE WHEN CAST(v AS DECIMAL(18,6)) = 0 AND starts_with(CAST(v AS VARCHAR), '-') THEN concat('-', CAST(CAST(v AS DECIMAL(18,6)) AS VARCHAR)) ELSE CAST(CAST(v AS DECIMAL(18,6)) AS VARCHAR) END AS score FROM (SELECT *, CAST(original AS FLOAT) AS v FROM plugin_numeric_sql_probe_src)
